name: Arab Republic of Egypt

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024. Surface area 1,001,450 km2 (AG.SRF.TOTL.K2); low is land area 995,450 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Includes the Halaib triangle as administered.

population.note: asOf 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 118,365,995). Low -1% / high +1.5% for 2026 growth and estimate uncertainty.

urbanization.note: asOf 2025: 42.90% urban (SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS, national definition). Egypt's narrow administrative definition understates urban settlement in the Nile delta.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2026 p.343 as quoted: 438,500 active (CIA Factbook 2025 ~450,000). Paramilitary 397,000 (Central Security Forces, National Guard) excluded.

trainedReserves.note: IISS Military Balance 2026: 479,000 reserves; conscripts carry a 9-year reserve obligation (CIA Factbook), so the pool is larger than the organised reserve.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 438,500 minus infantry P roles (220,000). Covers air force, air defence force (a separate service, ~80,000), navy, crews, logistics and staff.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Egypt's 1973 mobilisation (~800,000-1,000,000 of ~36 million, ~2.5%) scaled for total war with universal male conscription and a young population.

count.note: Educated guess. Mechanised/armoured divisions' infantry (Egypt fields 4 armoured + 8 mechanised divisions in IISS listings); share of 438,500 active. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Egyptian_Army)

training.note: Rubric 0.5: conscripts (14-36 months) with professional cadre; Sinai counter-insurgency experience.

commandQuality.note: Rubric 0.5: competent but centralised, conscript-heavy staff system; Sinai insurgency campaign mixed.

cohesion.note: Rubric 0.5: national conscript army with strong institutional identity (military dominates the state).

morale.note: Rubric 0.5: average; strong for defence of the Nile valley and Suez.

weapons.note: Anchor 9: guided missiles, Rafale/MICA, Hellfire; few precision long-range munitions.

armor.note: Anchor 9: M1A1 composite armour; most AFVs older.

ships.note: Anchor 9: FREMM, MEKO A200, Mistral LHDs.

fortification.note: Anchor 9: hardened air bases, dense SAM belts.

logistics.note: Anchor 9 minus: large conscript logistics, C-130/C-295 airlift.

isr.note: Anchor 9: E-2C, EgyptSat imaging satellites, MALE drones.

air.note: Anchor 9 plus: Rafale 4.5 generation; bulk F-16 Block 40.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 1,635,907,022,215 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD rebased x 0.8005) / population 118,365,995 = 13,821 2011 int$. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 2,043,606,523,692 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 1,635,907,022,215 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 0.61% of GDP in 2025 (1.12% 2021). SIPRI excludes off-budget military business revenues and US FMF (~$1.3 bn/yr), hence high 1.5% (educated).

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction (and hydrocarbons) 32.1% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-7% for oil-price swings.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. World's largest wheat importer; Nile agriculture feeds most of the rest.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 59,760,496 x share of males aged 15-19 9.445% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 1,128,849. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

armor.note: Educated guess. Factory 200 M1A1 co-production line (assembly ended; SA upgrades continue).

artillery.note: Educated guess. K9A1EGY licence production at Factory 200; D-30 licence.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Kader Factory (Fahd, Sinai 200, Temsah).

railKm.note: asOf 2016: 5,153 route-km (World Bank); CIA Factbook 5,085 km (2014).

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 31 ports, 5 large + 1 medium = 6; key ports Ain Sukhna, Alexandria, Suez, Port Said, Damietta, Ras Shukhier.

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: 1,935 thousand DWT under the Egyptian flag (1,289 thousand GT).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Truck-based; demonstrated air strikes in Libya, limited expeditionary land logistics.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Donkeys, horses, camels, buffalo used in agriculture; not from FAO data.

nuclearWarheads.note: Egypt is not listed among the nine nuclear-armed states in the FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 table.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: Suez Canal barrier, desert approaches, dense population support in the Nile valley.

notes: Peacetime snapshot (Gaza border tension, Red Sea traffic loss to Houthi attacks cut Suez revenue). asOf 2025 economic data, 2026 order of battle. Population: everything inside ne:EGY (World Bank). Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Counts from the Army equipment list, EAF and ADF inventory tables and the IISS 2020-based level-of-equipment list; ships_major = LHD + frigates. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Paramilitary (397,000) excluded. SIPRI military spending badly understates the real effort (note on milSpendShare).
